reviewPolicy: Count every controlled refusal on an answerable public question as incorrect.
Judge semantic correctness against the rendered source PDF when the public reference answer or Gold pages conflict with the source.
Do not modify frozen public labels; record dataset defects separately.
A cited statement may be supported while the answer remains incorrect because it is incomplete, irrelevant, or omits the requested calculation.
Mark citation support unsupported when the citation names the returned item but does not establish the relation asked by the question.
